annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires the client to set the probe timer when it has not received any acknowledgment for its Handshake packets and the handshake is not confirmed, regardless of whether packets are in flight. The wording is clear and the referenced definitions provide the necessary context, leaving no materially different implementation interpretations or missing constraints.
